name: Stanford University
summary: Stanford in California: undergraduates join Humanities and Sciences or Engineering; about 98% of eligible undergraduates live on campus.

ib.text: No courses or minimum scores are required for admission. Stanford reads IB results in the context of your school and country, with no GPA conversion; SAT or ACT scores are required.

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: A broad, rigorous training in the science of computing: a 96-unit major with a core, then a track such as artificial intelligence, systems, theory or human-computer interaction. No prior coding is assumed.
programmes.selectionNote: You apply to Stanford, not to a major. Admission reads the whole file: school results in context, essays, recommendations, SAT or ACT.

flagshipSource.title: Stanford Facts: the School of Engineering, nearly 5,000 students across nine departments

notes: Stanford is need-aware for non-US citizens: an international request for financial aid is a factor in admission, but it meets the full demonstrated need of everyone it admits.
2026-27 tuition is $67,731 and the full student budget is $97,545; an international applicant who does not request aid cannot apply for it later.
Housing is guaranteed to entering first-years for four years, in a system of 80 undergraduate residential facilities.
